about: Las Vegas Car Accident Attorney Law Firm is a personal injury firm with a single office in Las Vegas.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock; it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. G1.evidence: Nevada does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on the pages we could read, so there is nobody to look up. The register itself exists: Nevada publishes its attorney discipline as court decisions and we read them for the other firms in this market.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Nevada publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 28 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2021-07-28, so it has been operating for more than a year
